::: {#exm-mean-squares}
#### Mean squares of two small groups

For the groups of @exm-ss-between, $k = 2$ and $n = 6$, so

$$
\begin{aligned}
  \text{MS}_\text{between} &= 13.5 / 1 \\
  &= 13.5
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
  \text{MS}_\text{within} &= 4 / 4 \\
  &= 1.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
